title: Cover the remaining Resume reporter cancellation families
outcome: Regression tests prove that cancellation on session delete, dedicated runtime reset, Engram delivery rejection, revocation and token-mismatch release settles the exact feedback row once without provider delivery.
acceptance: Each listed cancellation family has a regression proving that the original feedback row reaches a terminal or Unknown disposition exactly once without provider delivery; existing detach, Stop, boot, buffering and persistence-failure coverage is preserved.
The added cancellation tests and maintained full gate pass on the resulting input.
